idea-plugin.description:
Queue up Claude Code tasks and run them one after another in your IDE terminal.
  • TODO / In progress / Done board — drag cards to reorder or to start them.
  • Tasks run in a real Claude Code terminal, so you can watch and step in at any time.
  • Pick which terminal a task runs in — a new tab, one the plugin opened, or a shell you opened yourself.
  • Completion is detected automatically and the next task starts on its own.
Requires the claude CLI on your PATH.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.4.0

  • Stop now leaves the running task alone and moves waiting tasks back to TODO, instead of marking them done while claude keeps working.
  • Type multi-line tasks — Enter adds, Shift+Enter breaks the line, and the Up arrow in an empty field opens your recent prompts.
  • Card buttons are ordered run, edit, delete, with bigger click targets.
  • Roomier board: a separator under each column header and more vertical padding.

0.3.1

  • Fixed: a terminal tab where you started claude yourself was rejected as "busy running something else".

0.3.0

  • Finished cards show claude's answer, so you don't have to open the terminal to see what happened. Notifications carry it too.
  • Running cards show elapsed time, updated every second.
  • Keyboard shortcuts on the board: Delete to remove, Cmd+Enter to run, F2 to edit.
  • Notifications go to the OS notification center instead of an IDE popup.

0.2.0

  • Run a task in any terminal tab — a new one, one the plugin opened, or a shell you opened yourself. If claude isn't running there yet, the plugin starts it.
  • Task completion is detected automatically and the next task starts on its own.
  • Drag cards to reorder them or to start them. Inline actions on each card (edit, run, delete) and a running-task card takes you to its terminal.
  • Notifications when a task finishes and when the queue drains.

action.description: Queue the selection or file as an automated task
